edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient for the reserved tokens in the constructor.
withdraw reads msg.sender as the ETH recipient and also as the onlyOwner check subject.
mint passes msg.sender as the recipient of the newly minted token.
mintSixPack passes msg.sender as the recipient for all six minted tokens.
The ETH transfer target is derived from msg.sender.
_getDistributionIndex mixes block.timestamp into the randomness seed, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is the entropy input of the weak randomness operation.
setPrice writes the new value into the price state variable.
toggleSale flips the saleIsActive state variable.
setBaseURI reads uriIsFrozen to decide whether the update is allowed.
setBaseURI sets _canFreezeUri to true after a successful update.
freezeBaseURI reads _canFreezeUri as the gating condition.
freezeBaseURI writes true into uriIsFrozen.
_setBaseURI writes the supplied URI into _baseTokenURI.
_baseURI returns the _baseTokenURI storage variable.
mint requires saleIsActive to be true.
mint checks totalSupply against MAX_SUPPLY.
mint compares msg.value against the price state variable.
mintSixPack requires saleIsActive to be true.
mintSixPack checks totalSupply + 6 against MAX_SUPPLY.
mintSixPack compares msg.value against price * 6.
giveaway checks totalSupply against MAX_SUPPLY.
_mintSoda writes the chosen distribution index into the distributionIndex mapping.
_getDistributionIndex uses MAX_SUPPLY to bound the modulo range.
constructor loops over the RESERVED constant while minting.
constructor compares the loop index with FANBOI to decide randomness.
constructor calls _setBaseURI to initialize the metadata URI.
constructor calls _mintSoda for each reserved token.
setBaseURI delegates the storage write to _setBaseURI.
mint calls _mintSoda to perform the actual mint.
mintSixPack calls _mintSoda six times in a loop.
giveaway calls _mintSoda to mint the free token.
_mintSoda calls _getDistributionIndex when randomness is requested.
_mintSoda calls _safeMint to mint and notify the recipient.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
withdraw performs the ETH transfer unsafe operation after reading the balance.
The local balance variable is the amount sent by the ETH transfer.
_getDistributionIndex performs the weak randomness computation.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external call to onERC721Received on the recipient, opening a reentrancy path.
_safeMint triggers the recipient callback through _checkOnERC721Received.
_mintSoda indirectly triggers the onERC721Received callback via _safeMint.
mint reaches the recipient callback through _mintSoda and _safeMint before state is fully settled.
mintSixPack reaches the recipient callback repeatedly through the mint loop.
The baseURI parameter is consumed by setBaseURI.
The uri parameter is written into storage by _setBaseURI.
The newPrice parameter is consumed by setPrice.
The nftOwner parameter is the mint recipient in giveaway.
The nftOwner parameter is forwarded to _safeMint inside _mintSoda.
The isRandom parameter selects between random and zero distribution index.
The index parameter is used as the token id and mapping key in _mintSoda.
The index parameter seeds the randomness computation in _getDistributionIndex.
The _owner parameter selects which balance and tokens are enumerated.
The name_ parameter is passed to the ERC721 base constructor.
The symbol_ parameter is passed to the ERC721 base constructor.
tokenCount determines the size of the returned array in walletOfOwner.
tokensId is the array returned by walletOfOwner.
The loop counter i bounds the minting loop in mintSixPack.
magicNumber holds the pseudo-random value produced in _getDistributionIndex.
msg.sender is passed as nftOwner to _mintSoda from mint and mintSixPack.
